ruleDefinitions.name: Arbitrary DLL or Csproj Code Execution Via Dotnet.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of arbitrary DLLs or unsigned code via a ".csproj" files via Dotnet.EXE.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\dotnet\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "\.NET\ Host") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\\.csproj$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.csproj\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.csproj\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll\\$")))
